name: Ocean Cliff
description: A GPU FLIP cove at the foot of a photoscanned sea cliff inside the open FFT ocean: a wave-maker paddle at the sea end, driven by an LFO, sends waves that break into the rock, and the cove rests just under the ocean so each surge rises out of it.

params.name: Stretch
params.tooltip: Stretch particles along the local flow to join the surface.

params.name: Centre Smoothing
params.tooltip: Move surface particles toward their neighbours for a smoother sheet.

params.name: Fill Pits
params.tooltip: Fill surface dips; distance is measured in particle bins.
